fixes.explanation: Paul says, "…when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest." He has just asked if God is really concerned about oxen, and he says this was written for us. So the point isn't about oxen at all. People who do the hard work of spreading the gospel can expect to be supported by the people they serve, and that's why Paul goes on to say, "If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?" (1 Corinthians 9:11).
